lock_backup: /* odi87:lock_backup */ LOCK TABLE "DWH"."ODI87_DIM_PRODUCT_MIG_BKP" IN EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT
lock_target: /* odi87:lock_target */ LOCK TABLE "DWH"."DIM_PRODUCT" IN EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT
migrate: /* odi87:migrate_update */ UPDATE "DWH"."DIM_PRODUCT" SET "CURRENT_FLAG" = CASE "CURRENT_FLAG" WHEN 'Y' THEN '1' WHEN 'N' THEN '0' ELSE "CURRENT_FLAG" END, "EFFECTIVE_TO" = CASE WHEN "EFFECTIVE_TO" = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN DATE '2400-01-01' ELSE "EFFECTIVE_TO" END WHERE "CURRENT_FLAG" IN ('Y', 'N') OR "EFFECTIVE_TO" = DATE '9999-12-31'
read_committed: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
restore: /* odi87:restore_update */ UPDATE "DWH"."DIM_PRODUCT" t SET ("CURRENT_FLAG", "EFFECTIVE_TO") = (SELECT b."CURRENT_FLAG", b."EFFECTIVE_TO" FROM "DWH"."ODI87_DIM_PRODUCT_MIG_BKP" b WHERE b."PRODUCT_SK" = t."PRODUCT_SK") WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "DWH"."ODI87_DIM_PRODUCT_MIG_BKP" b WHERE b."PRODUCT_SK" = t."PRODUCT_SK")
stock_invalid_effective: "EFFECTIVE_FROM" > "EFFECTIVE_TO" OR "EFFECTIVE_TO" >= DATE '9999-12-31' OR ("CURRENT_FLAG" = '1' AND "EFFECTIVE_TO" <> DATE '2400-01-01') OR ("CURRENT_FLAG" = '1' AND "EFFECTIVE_FROM" > DATE '2400-01-01') OR ("CURRENT_FLAG" = '0' AND "EFFECTIVE_TO" >= DATE '2400-01-01')
